# Files generated by Tack

- Text between `<!-- BEGIN:tack` and `<!-- END:tack -->`, sub-agent files in `.claude/agents/` and `.codex/agents/`, and other files that say they are generated by Tack are outputs. Never edit them.
- Links in `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/rules/` and `.agents/skills/` lead to the sources. Edit sources only under the `tack-improve` skill.
- To change what an output says, find the source with `npx tack why <ID>` and use the `tack-improve` skill.
- After changing `tack.json` or a harness file, run `npx tack sync`.
